name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PrivateMIFE.native_ciphertext_rows
title: Native-output ciphertext floor for sixteen prefix and slot groups
statement: Any at most sixteen grouped widths totaling 128 bits need at least 4096 total exponential rows. At 2 N width field bits per row with N width field at least 2^19 the required serialization reaches 2^32.
